title: Romance Rollout Series
description: A reference-dependent Valentines campaign series that locks a refined romance language and extends it across gifting and dining surfaces.
creative_direction: Image 01 establishes a tasteful romance world built from florals, candlelight, satin texture, and premium gifting surfaces; images 02-04 preserve the exact brand mood while moving between jewelry, dining, and beauty-adjacent offers.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-rose-dinner-anchor first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-jewelry-gift-variation, 03-intimate-dining-variation, 04-beauty-escape-variation. Queue may run the dependent images concurrently after 01-rose-dinner-anchor is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
